description: Every Domotz endpoint, plus a local SQLite fleet mirror that answers cross-site questions.

novel_features.name: Fleet health rollup
novel_features.description: One status board across every Domotz Collector: online/offline agents, degraded sites, and down-device counts per site.

novel_features.name: Cross-site offline devices
novel_features.description: Every unreachable or offline device across all sites in one prioritized list, with site and importance.

novel_features.name: New / rogue device detection
novel_features.description: Devices first-seen anywhere in the fleet within a time window — a rogue-device security signal.

novel_features.name: Unified fleet inventory export
novel_features.description: One asset table — vendor, model, type, OS, serial, site — for every device across every agent.

novel_features.name: Active alerts & sensor rollup
novel_features.description: Alert profiles (alerting rules) and their device bindings, aggregated across the fleet.

novel_features.name: Fleet IP-conflict sweep
novel_features.description: IP address conflicts across all sites in one prioritized list.

novel_features.name: Device-type & vendor breakdown
novel_features.description: Counts of devices by type, vendor, and OS across the fleet for capacity and security posture.

novel_features.name: WAN speed-test trends
novel_features.description: Per-site WAN speed-test history aggregated into fleet min/avg/max and a worst-site ranking.

novel_features.name: Offline network topology
novel_features.description: Cached network topology for a site, summarized (node/edge counts, gateways) and queryable offline.

novel_features.name: Config / inventory drift
novel_features.description: Diffs two local snapshots for a site to surface configuration and inventory changes over time.

novel_features.name: Fleet degraded-agent sweep
novel_features.description: Only the sites (Collectors) that are offline or degraded right now, with location, organization, and version, in one prioritized list.

novel_features.name: Stale-agent / sync-freshness check
novel_features.description: Collectors whose local snapshot has gone quiet — last-synced or last-seen older than a threshold, a silent monitoring blind spot.

novel_features.name: Fleet down-sensor sweep
novel_features.description: TCP service sensors (eyes) currently DOWN across every device on every agent, in one fleet-wide list.

novel_features.name: Monitoring-coverage audit
novel_features.description: Devices Domotz can't fully monitor — failed or missing authentication and SNMP status — surfaced fleet-wide as a coverage-gap audit.

novel_features.name: Fleet event timeline
novel_features.description: Per-agent activity-log and network-event history merged into one chronological fleet-wide timeline.

novel_features.name: Fleet alert-coverage audit
novel_features.description: Devices no enabled alert profile watches, across every Collector, VITAL first: the devices that can go down without anyone being told.
